items.question: Are prices per user?
items.answer: Yes. Prices are in Algerian dinars (DZD), per user, per month or per year.

items.question: Can I start for free?
items.answer: Yes. The Free plan is limited to one user and includes credit sales and contacts.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: By CCP, bank transfer or cash. Terms are set out in your quote.

items.question: Can I change plan later?
items.answer: Yes, you can move to a higher plan as your team grows. Terms are set out when you subscribe.

items.question: Are prices final?
items.answer: No, they are indicative. The final amount is confirmed before you subscribe.

items.question: Can I keep my data on my own servers?
items.answer: Yes, for companies that must keep their data in Algeria. See the On-premise page.

bottomCta.title: A plan to start tomorrow
bottomCta.body: Create your account, add your customers and your first credit sale in a few minutes.

indexMeta.title: Solutions by business | Tavio
indexMeta.description: Tavio for appliance and furniture shops, car dealers, clinics, training centres and retail shops with a till.

solutions.indexBody: Every business sells and collects differently. Pick the page that looks like your day.
solutions.ctaTitle: Try it with your own customers
solutions.ctaBody: Create your account for free and set up your first payment plan in a few minutes.

electromenager-credit.title: Appliance and furniture shops on credit
electromenager-credit.short: Sell on credit and track every instalment, from the first payment to the last.
electromenager-credit.problem: Your customers buy on credit, but instalments are written in notebooks. You do not always know who owes what, or who is late.
electromenager-credit.solution: Set up an instalment plan for each customer, track paid and late instalments, and send a reminder in one click. Every invoice stays linked to its file.

car-dealers.title: Car dealers
car-dealers.short: Follow every prospect, deposit and vehicle in one place.
car-dealers.problem: Each vehicle has its own file, deposits and prospects. The information is spread across files, messages and notebooks.
car-dealers.solution: A sales pipeline to follow each prospect, quotes and invoices for each sale, and stock tracking so you know what is still available.

clinics.title: Clinics and practices
clinics.short: Customer files, VAT invoicing and instalment payments, in one tool.
clinics.problem: Patients pay in several instalments, services must be invoiced cleanly, and records are hard to find when you need them.
clinics.solution: Customer files, clear VAT invoices, instalment payments with reminders, and access from a phone, in Arabic or French.

training-centers.title: Training centres
training-centers.short: Enrolments, instalment payments and accounts tracked in one application.
training-centers.problem: Enrolments come in through several channels, payments are made in instalments, and the accounts struggle to keep up.
training-centers.solution: Follow prospects and enrolments, invoice each course, manage payment schedules, and keep general accounts fed by your sales.

retail-pos.title: Retail shops with a till
retail-pos.short: A fast till, an up-to-date stock and an invoice for every sale.
retail-pos.problem: The till, the stock and the invoices do not talk to each other. You find out about stock-outs too late and the books are done by hand.
retail-pos.solution: A till that is simple to use, stock updated with every sale, restock alerts and invoices ready to print.

meta.title: On-premise | Tavio
meta.description: Install Tavio on your own servers in Algeria, with Docker, backups and installation support.

onPremise.title: Keep your data in Algeria
onPremise.body: Some companies must keep their data on Algerian soil. Tavio can run on your own servers, with Docker.
onPremise.legal: ⚠ Legal framework (Law 18-07 on personal data protection): to be reviewed by a lawyer before publication.
onPremise.requirementsTitle: What you need to install it
requirements: Docker Engine 24 or later, with the Compose plugin
A server with at least 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM and 40 GB disk
A domain name and an HTTPS reverse proxy (Caddy, nginx or Traefik)

steps.title: Prepare the server
steps.body: Install Docker, open only the HTTPS port to the proxy, and keep the database closed to the internet.

steps.title: Configure and start
steps.body: Fill in the environment file (secrets, public URL, S3 storage), then start the containers. Migrations apply automatically.

steps.title: Update
steps.body: Back up, fetch the new release and restart the containers. Migrations already applied are not run again.

backups: A database backup is created by script, compressed and kept for 14 days.
Files (invoices, attachments) are backed up on the same schedule as the database.
Restore runs on an empty database, in a few documented commands.
included: The full application, with all the modules of your plan
Help with the first setup, on request
onPremise.support: Installation help and a support contract are available on request. Terms are set out in your quote.
onPremise.ctaBody: Tell us how many users you are and what data constraints you have. We will get back to you.
